name: 43403 · Bowling Green, OH
findings: ZIP 43403 (Bowling Green) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (75% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43403 (Bowling Green) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
